clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Innkeeper Keldamyr offers food, drink, and a place to rest. Young night elves leaving Shadowglen can find shelter at his inn beneath the boughs of the World Tree.

Dolanaar is the first village many newcomers reach after leaving the sheltered glade of Aldrassil. At the village's central inn, Innkeeper Keldamyr offers bread, spring water, and soft beds beneath Teldrassil's canopy. Travelers, sentinels, and young novices bound for Darnassus pause at his counter to rest, bind their Hearthstones, and gather rations for the journey through the boughs.

An inn high among the branches depends on steady supplies from nearby settlements and tradesfolk. Couriers bringing goods are often sent to Keldamyr's desk, tying his inn to the daily trade that keeps Dolanaar running.
